title: Setup: Deactivate and Reactivate are hidden without the admin plugin, though both doors now work there
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5nWoa1Ze1QzjRTSYXD

Filing gate: ③ a follow-up named by #33227's hand-over and raised as an open question by the #33186 dev (os-dev report 6892329704 on PR #33755); the seat answered it "own card".
Reader: `domain:ui` (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`, `ban_user` / `unban_user`). Grade p2, self-graded by the seat: deactivating a person is part of the managed onboarding path (cloud#4465; #33227 added the host's `userDeactivated` / `userReactivated` events), and a managed environment may run without the admin plugin.
Dedupe: `is:issue is:open ban_user requiresFeature admin` finds nothing.

## 维护者速读

#33227 之后，「停用 / 恢复用户」接口在没有开启 admin 插件时也能用了，但界面上这两个按钮仍要求 admin 插件才显示。所以没开 admin 插件的环境（包括托管环境）里管理员看不到停用按钮。应当去掉这个限制，其他条件不变。

## Facts

- PR #33227 (`cbb876c1`): `admin/ban-user` and `admin/unban-user` work without the better-auth admin plugin; a banned row is refused a session with `403 BANNED_USER`.
- `sys_user.ban_user` and `unban_user` still carry `requiresFeature: 'admin'`, so they are hidden wherever `features.admin` is off.

## Ask

Drop `requiresFeature: 'admin'` from `ban_user` and `unban_user` only. Keep their row-state predicates and `requiredPermissions` as they are, and leave every other admin-plugin action as it is. Measure first which kernels gain the two actions (managed and unmanaged without the admin plugin) and state it on the `Clause-②:` line. Pins: offered with `features.admin` off; a live pin bans and unbans through the real door with the admin plugin off; CONTROL: an admin-plugin-only action stays hidden there.
